STEP 9. Check the harness wires between column switch 
connector C-86 and ETACS-ECU connector C-111.
NOTE: After checking joint connector C-78, check the wires. If 
joint connector C-78 is damaged, repair or replace it. Refer to 
GROUP 00E, Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between column switch 
connector C-86 and ETACS-ECU connector C-111 in 
good condition?
YES : Go to Step 10.
NO : Repair them. Confirm the DTC 12 is not displayed.
STEP 10. Replacement of ECU.
(1) Replace the column switch.
(2) Confirm the DTC 12 is not displayed.
Q: Does DTC 12 set?
YES : Replace the ETACS-ECU. Confirm the DTC 12 is not 
displayed.
NO : There is no action to taken.
